paper.title: Efficient Responsivity Enhancement of Surface-Illuminated InGaAs Avalanche Photodiode by Photon Trapping on the SOI Substrate

scope: ONE two-dimensional three-hole x-z section; no 3D or full mesa, no SDevice
units: geometry nm in Workbench, um in SDE; doping cm^-3

Tp_nm.basis: Fig.3 scale: bottom III-V contact approximately z=0..100 nm

Tg_nm.basis: Fig.3/4 layer allocation approximately 350..400 nm; not an epitaxial table

Tc_nm.basis: Fig.3/4 layer allocation approximately 400..450 nm; not an epitaxial table

engineering_assumptions.hole_fill: SU8 after adhesive bonding; not explicitly specified; may be changed for a void model
engineering_assumptions.charge_rationale: Order-of-magnitude sheet charge from Gauss law for a several 1e5 V/cm field difference at 50 nm; not fitted or electrically validated
engineering_assumptions.grade: 8 intrinsic AlInGaAs composition slices; Al=0..0.48 and In=0.53..0.52
engineering_assumptions.contacts: Equivalent n++ upper plane and four p++ bottom segments; real metal pad dimensions unavailable
engineering_assumptions.substrate: 220 nm SOI device silicon, assumed BOX and truncated handle; not full wafer
engineering_assumptions.out_of_plane: 2D translational section; cannot reproduce a 2D photonic crystal quantitatively

geometry.coordinate_mapping: SDE X=paper x; SDE Y=paper z

related_literature_check: Same-team flexible APD paper DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-64401-2 has 2 um absorber/1.2 um multiplication layer, so its stack was not substituted for this TED device.
